## 🔗 Related Issue
Closes the failing "testing-up" target:
```
$ make testing-up
🧪 Starting testing stack (fast_test_server)...
   🦗 Locust workers: 1 (override: TESTING_LOCUST_WORKERS=4 make testing-up)
/bin/bash: line 1: IMAGE_LOCAL: unbound variable
make: *** [Makefile:1678: testing-up] Error 1

```

---

## 📝 Summary

The interpolation of env variable in make file fails and target "testing-up" fails as well, replacement of env var with make file var fixes this.
